workload.unit: nanoseconds per formatted error across the complete fixed variant/payload corpus
workload.selection: Every selected variant; nested BirthMessage/EdIdentity values cover every IdentityError; three fixed ASCII/Unicode/quoted-newline payloads for each string field.

workload.paired_order: Seven pairs; baseline,candidate for even pair index; candidate,baseline for odd.
workload.anti_elision: black_box input error reference and checksum; assert per-cycle byte-length checksum times cycles; no allocations of fixture corpus in timed interval
workload.targets: Separate fresh baseline/candidate targets, same populated registry cache
workload.format: Local aarch64 Mach-O; no ELF/full-app/cold-platform inference
